title: Rigorix Authority Fact Bundle v1
description: The consequence-gating §4.3 authority-fact projection bundle: the projection, the signed history it was derived from, and the subjects the consumer asked about (`subjects_without_record`). Rigorix exports its own hash-chained history as attributable present-state facts for an external determination consumer; the projection reports what was established, when, and how it can be verified, and SHALL NOT assert present standing (NC-4). Verification is by RE-DERIVATION, not by signature (spec §4.3.1): a verifier checks the envelope chain, re-derives the projection from that verified history, and compares the facts and anchor reference exactly (the `generated_at` timestamp is not compared). The `envelopes[]` items are `$ref`-addressed to the one canonical envelope dialect (`envelope-v2.json`) — this schema never re-declares envelope fields. DISCLOSURE: a bundle carries the envelopes, so a caller receives the signed history, not a summary; that is inherent to re-derivation and is declared, not discovered.

envelopes.description: The signed history the projection was derived from. Each item is the ONE canonical envelope dialect (`envelope.json`, `$id` `envelope-v2.json`) — referenced, never re-declared, so there is no second envelope shape.

subjects_without_record.description: The subjects the consumer asked about that had no record. Carried so re-derivation is reproducible: without it the `NOT_ESTABLISHED` facts cannot be regenerated and the check would silently be incomplete. Absent (serde default) is treated as empty, not as an error.

projection.description: A versioned, offline-verifiable projection of authority facts (mirrors rigorix-oss `AuthorityFactProjection`).

generated_at.description: When the projection was generated. NOT compared by re-derivation (not reproducible).

claimCeiling.description: The machine-readable claim ceiling carried by a projection (spec §6). Carried as data, not prose, so a summarizer cannot drop it.

layer.description: The evidence layer this projection establishes at (e.g. `engineering_verification`).

asserts_present_standing.description: Always `false`: the projection never asserts present standing.

anchorRef.description: The anchor reference for a projection: the chain tip that lets a third party verify lineage (ADR-016).

history_integrity.description: The `history_integrity` marker of the tip (`local_unanchored` / `anchored`); null when the tip has none.

producer_id.description: The producer the chain belongs to, when present.

authorityFact.description: One attributable present-state fact (mirrors rigorix-oss `AuthorityFact`). It carries an `outcome` and an `authority_digest` when a record has them — never an assertion that the authority is presently valid.

subject.description: The subject the fact is about (e.g. `authority:beneficiary-eligible`). Redaction-safe: no absolute path, no username, no secret.

scope.description: The operator's scope token the fact was recorded under.

established_at.description: When the underlying record established the fact.

epistemic_status.description: `NOT_ESTABLISHED` means the fact is absent from the record. It is not a refusal and SHALL NOT be rendered as one, and SHALL NOT be promoted to a positive.

authority_digest.description: The one-way digest binding the authority artifact, when the record has one. Absent ≠ tampered.

evidence_refs.description: The records this fact is attributed to. Never empty for `ESTABLISHED`.

chain_position.description: The chain position (sequence) of the record that established the fact.

producer_id.description: The producer id of the record, when present.

evidenceRef.description: The one-way link from a fact to the record it is attributed to (mirrors rigorix-oss `EvidenceRef`).

reference.description: A stable, redaction-safe reference into the record (`<execution-id>#<precondition-id>@<sequence>`).

steps: verify the envelope chain (verify_chain) — unverified history re-derives to unverified facts, so it is checked first
re-derive the projection from that verified history with the same derivation the producer used
compare the facts and the anchor reference exactly; generated_at is not compared
x-verification.signed-optimisation: Documented as deferred (spec §4.3.2). A future signed/cached projection MUST be anchored to the chain, or verification degrades from 'consistent with the anchored chain' to 'asserted by a key holder'.
